item.title: Axpo LNG bunkering vessel starts operations
item.description: Axpo’s new LNG bunkering vessel is ready to commence operations at the Port of Genoa.

item.title: Open season launches for Zeeland Energy Terminal
item.description: VTTI and Höegh Evi have launched the open season for the Zeeland Energy Terminal.

item.title: OceanScore reaches US$5 million in annual recurring revenue
item.description: OceanScore has reached US$5 million in annual recurring revenue as demand for commercial emissions compliance accelerates.

item.title: TECNIMONT (MAIRE) and Baker Hughes to collaborate on LNG initiatives globally
item.description: TECNIMONT and Baker Hughes have signed a memorandum of understanding to collaborate on prospective modularised, scalable LNG projects.

item.title: Wood Mackenzie forecasts requirement for over 650 new LNG carriers by 2040
item.description: The global LNG shipping industry will require over 650 new LNG carriers by 2040, according to analysis by Wood Mackenzie.

item.title: GTT receives an order from HD KSOE for tank design of four new LNG carriers
item.description: GTT has received an order from HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering for the tank design of four new LNG carriers.

item.title: PETRONAS signs 20-year LNG supply agreement with QatarEnergy
item.description: PETRONAS has signed a 20-year LNG sale and purchase agreement with QatarEnergy.

item.title: Mugardos Energy Terminal offers bioLNG
item.description: The Mugardos Energy Terminal is now ready to supply bioLNG to ships and tankers.

item.title: Commonwealth LNG sign 20-year LNG SPA with Mercuria
item.description: Commonwealth LNG has signed a 20-year sale and gas supply agreement with Mercuria.

item.title: Security and sustainability in Europe's LNG landscape
item.description: In the February 2026 issue of LNG Industry, Abby Butler, Editorial Assistant, LNG Industry, highlights some key European import trends and developments. This special report lists all the sources used for this article.
